articles.summary: GSK (LSE:GSK) received accelerated FDA approval for Jemperli as the first immunotherapy for certain rectal cancer patients. The approval covers a genetically defined group of rectal cancer cases where Jemperli offers a non surgical treatment option. GSK presented updated data for Mo-Rez in ovarian and endometrial cancers and Ris-Rez in small cell lung cancer at ESMO 2026.
